# claude-skill-isolved-jobs-api

A [Claude and agent skill](https://agentskills.io/specification) for scraping isolved jobs, powered by the [isolved Jobs API](https://apify.com/johnvc/isolved-jobs-api?fpr=9n7kx3&fp_sid=skillrepo) on Apify. Installs in Claude Code, Cursor, and other skills-compatible agents.

## What it does

Scrape isolved and ApplicantPro jobs from any isolvedhire.com career site as structured rows, with a real new-or-changed feed from each posting's lastmod and the description as Markdown.

## Install

```bash
npx skills add johnisanerd/claude-skill-isolved-jobs-api
```

The skill lives in the `apify-isolved-jobs-api/` folder. You can also copy that folder straight into your agent's skills directory.

## Powered by

- Actor: [isolved Jobs API](https://apify.com/johnvc/isolved-jobs-api?fpr=9n7kx3&fp_sid=skillrepo) (pay per event, no start fee, MCP-ready)
- Companion skill: [claude-skill-companies-using-isolved](https://github.com/johnisanerd/claude-skill-companies-using-isolved)
